name: Maraschino Margarita
desc: A long tequila and pineapple margarita built in parts with Luxardo maraschino and Cointreau.

source.evidence: Searched for a margarita combining pineapple juice, Luxardo maraschino, Cointreau and Grand Marnier; found Grand Marnier and pineapple margaritas but none with this combination.

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp coarse salt, for the rim

steps: Pick a part size: 3/4 oz per part makes one tall drink of about 7 oz (1 1/2 oz tequila), 1/2 oz per part makes one rocks-glass drink, and 1/2 cup per part makes a pitcher for about 6.
Spread the salt on a small plate. Rub the lime wedge around the glass rim, dip the rim in the salt, and fill the glass with fresh ice.
Add the tequila, lime juice, pineapple juice, Cointreau, maraschino and Grand Marnier to a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously until the outside of the shaker frosts, about 15 seconds.
Strain into the glass and garnish with the lime wheel.
tips: Luxardo maraschino is a clear, dry cherry liqueur; the red syrup from a jar of maraschino cherries is not a substitute.
